formatting_standard_used: Keep the person name and honorifics in the same order unless a separate HR confirmation is listed.
Use a comma before each post-nominal credential and a terminal period for abbreviated credentials.
Use common forms such as S.AB., M.AB., S.ST., S.HI., S.IP., M.MR., and M.Pd.I.
Do not treat a difference in the live database as automatically correct because that source also contains inconsistent formatting.
